title: Digital Skills for Work
tagline: Documents, research, and online job applications.
description: Write a CV on your phone, search for jobs safely, and send an application by email. Skills that help you find and keep work.
outcomes: Write a simple CV on your phone
Search for jobs and avoid fake offers

lessons.title: Writing a CV on your phone
lessons.body:
A CV is a short page that tells an employer who you are and what you can do.

## What to include
Your name, phone number and email. Your education. Work you have done, including piece work and volunteering. Skills like driving, tailoring or speaking Bemba and English.

## Writing it
Use a free app like Google Docs. Keep it to one page. Save it as a PDF to send.
key_points: Keep your CV to one page
Include all work, even informal work
lessons.try_it: Write the first three lines of your CV: name, phone, email.

lessons.title: Spotting fake job offers
lessons.body:
Fake job adverts ask you to pay money for a job, training or a uniform before you start.

## Warning signs
They ask for payment. The salary is very high for little work. They only talk on WhatsApp and have no office address. Real employers do not charge you to apply.
key_points: Real employers never charge you to apply
Very high pay is a warning
Check there is a real address
lessons.try_it: Look at one job advert and check it for warning signs.

lessons.title: Sending an application by email
lessons.body:
When you email an application, write a short message and attach your CV.

## Example
Subject: Application for Shop Assistant. Message: Dear Sir or Madam, I would like to apply for the Shop Assistant job in Kitwe. My CV is attached. Thank you, Mwaka Banda, 097 000 0000.
key_points: Keep the message short and polite
lessons.try_it: Write a practice email to yourself with your CV attached.

quiz.question: An advert asks you to pay K300 for a uniform before starting. This is:
options: A warning sign of a fake job
quiz.explanation: Real employers do not charge you money to get a job.

quiz.question: How long should a simple CV be?
quiz.explanation: One clear page is easiest for employers to read.
